tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background on every screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Answer options, cards, the result headline card and form fields, on top of `surface`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text: statements, headings, body. Reads on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: progress labels, source lines under figures, band labels, helper text. Reads on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and the resting track line on results. Never the only thing marking a control's edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of answer options, inputs and checkboxes, at least 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons, the selected answer, the 'You' marker on tracks, links, the progress bar and the focus ring. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet tint behind the selected answer row and the result headline card. `ink` and `accent` both read on it.

tokens.name: second
tokens.usage: Only the friend's marker in comparisons (always a ring shape and a name label, never colour alone). Reads on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Noto Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The perspective name on the result headline card. 44px/52px on screens wider than 640px. One per page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page and section headings. 32px/40px on screens wider than 640px. More space above a heading than below it.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: Some decisions should always be made by a human, even if an AI would make them more accurately.
styles.usage: Survey statements and scenario text. 28px/36px on screens wider than 640px. 22px on phones so the statement and all seven answers fit on one screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You expect AI to bring both large benefits and serious harms.
styles.usage: Running text and result copy, at every screen size. Lines no longer than about 66 characters.

styles.name: option
styles.usage: Answer option labels and button text. 700 when selected.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Research Co., 2025 · 1,001 Canadian adults, online panel
styles.usage: Source lines, helper text, labels, footer links. The smallest text anywhere: nothing goes below 16px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; icon-to-text gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between answer option rows; minimum gap between any two tap targets.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside compact controls; gap inside small cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutters on phones; padding inside answer rows and cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section; side gutters on larger screens.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on the results page.

tokens.name: tap-option
tokens.usage: Minimum height of an answer row, with 6px between rows, so all seven answers fit above the fold on a phone. Never smaller.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every other button, link-button and icon button.

tokens.name: measure-body
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the reading and question column on every screen size.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Answer option rows, cards, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Perspective chips and track markers only.
